entries: **Antigravity shows your Gemini quota again.** Google's quota summary no longer returns the Gemini group. usage now reads Gemini's five-hour quota from the model list. Google does not currently report its weekly quota; the card labels it as not reported. While the app is running, the Antigravity CLI status line uses these numbers too.
**The Antigravity 5-hour row says "Paused" once the weekly quota is used up.** Google pauses the 5-hour limit at that point, and the row used to read "0% used / Quota full", which looked usable.

**The Antigravity group toggle is hidden when there is nothing to switch to.** v0.33.6 meant to hide it when Google's quota response carries only one model group, but the change missed the panel code the app loads, so every panel still showed a toggle that did nothing. When the Gemini group comes back, the toggle reappears on the next refresh and your saved choice applies again.

**The usage report explains its numbers instead of leaving units to guess.** Token composition and cache hit rate now sit in a visible section after tools rather than the collapsed appendix. The daily chart labels the peak's date, marks month starts and uses rounder axis steps; weekly rows show their date range; project hotspots add a share column and an "Other projects" row; the dispatch ledger and persona peak state what their numbers count.

**Reports keep usage older than 30 days even if you rarely open them.** Claude Code deletes transcripts after 30 days by default, and usage only saved its long-term history when a report was built. The menu bar and Windows tray apps now save the last 45 days every 6 hours in the background, and reports fill days missing from transcripts from that saved history. Filled days count toward totals, trends, tools and projects, but not sessions, token composition or cache hit rate. When moving to a new computer, copy `~/.usage/` as well.

**The Antigravity group toggle no longer stops working.** When one quota response skipped a model group, the card had nothing to switch to for five minutes. A group seen in the last 30 minutes is now kept. When the quota really has only one group, every panel and the Windows tray hide the toggle, and your group choice is kept for when both return.

**Windows tray-icon menus stay outside the taskbar.** Right-clicking the tray icon now uses the same taskbar-aware position and foreground owner as the quota label, preventing the taskbar from covering the menu. Left-click behavior is unchanged.

**Windows: hardened three native calls that may relate to crashes while the screen is locked (#202).** The tray icon is no longer redrawn by two threads at once, Windows handles are no longer cut to 32 bits, and the file watcher waits for a pending read to finish before closing it. The crash cause is not yet confirmed.

**Windows: usage no longer leaves a WebView2 folder in %TEMP% after each abnormal exit.** Each crash, forced close or shutdown with Windows previously left about 2.5 MB behind. usage now reuses one dedicated folder under `~/.usage/webview`.

**Sonnet 5.5 cache reads in the offline price table cost $0.10 per million tokens.** The table, used only when the LiteLLM download fails, still charged $0.20, so offline Sonnet 5.5 spending was overstated.

**Session resume no longer hands over another open window's work.** With several Claude Code windows in one project, a new window picked up whichever session was written last, often a neighbour still running. Sessions another window has open and wrote to in the last 10 minutes are now skipped; a window you just closed is still handed over. Background-task notices, `!` shell runs and bare slash commands no longer show up as your recent requests.

**Beginner Mode's terms stay up while background agents work.** Since Claude Code 2.1.299, a subagent or teammate starting its own turn also signals a new turn, which cleared the terms above the prompt and dropped the ones still being picked. Only a new turn in the main conversation clears them now.

title.zh-TW: Windows 異常結束不再堆積暫存檔，固定重複使用單一資料夾
title.en: Abnormal Windows Exits No Longer Accumulate Temp Files, Reusing a Dedicated Folder

body.zh-TW: 你在 Windows 上使用 usage 時，若遇到系統關機或程式無預警閃退，硬碟空間常會不知不覺被吃掉。以前每次當掉、強制關閉或隨 Windows 關機，都會在暫存目錄 `%TEMP%` 留下約 2.5 MB 的 WebView2（微軟讓桌面程式顯示網頁畫面的組件）資料夾。隨著閃退次數增加，這些殘留檔案就會越積越多。現在 usage 改為重複使用 `~/.usage/webview` 這一個專屬資料夾，就算異常結束也不會再塞爆暫存區。⟦如同使用健身房的固定置物櫃，以前每次臨時離開都換鎖霸占一個新櫃子，現在不管來幾次都共用同一個號碼櫃，儲物區不會再堆滿垃圾。⟧
body.en: When using usage on Windows, system shutdowns or unexpected crashes used to quietly eat up disk space. Previously, every crash, forced quit, or Windows shutdown left behind a WebView2 (Microsoft's component for rendering web content in desktop apps) folder of about 2.5 MB in the `%TEMP%` directory. As crashes piled up, these leftover files continued to accumulate. Now usage reuses a single dedicated `~/.usage/webview` folder, so abnormal exits will no longer fill up the temp directory. ⟦Think of having a fixed gym locker: leaving unexpectedly used to mean locking and occupying a new locker every time, but now you reuse the same numbered locker no matter how many times you come, so the storage area never piles up with clutter.⟧

items.original: **Windows: usage no longer leaves a WebView2 folder in %TEMP% after each abnormal exit.** Each crash, forced close or shutdown with Windows previously left about 2.5 MB behind. usage now reuses one dedicated folder under `~/.usage/webview`.

title.zh-TW: 離線備用價目表修正 Sonnet 5.5 快取費率，花費不再高估
title.en: Offline Fallback Pricing Corrects Sonnet 5.5 Cache Rates, Preventing Cost Overestimation

body.zh-TW: 當 LiteLLM 價目表下載失敗時，你看到的 Sonnet 5.5 花費可能被高估。usage 平常會連線下載 LiteLLM 價目表，只有在下載失敗時才會啟用備用清單。但這張備援表過去仍記載舊費率，把 Sonnet 5.5 讀取快取（把算過的結果暫存起來直接用）的費用算得太貴。現在這份離線價目表已經修正，讀取計價由每百萬 token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）$0.20 改為 $0.10，不再把 Sonnet 5.5 的離線花費算高。⟦你拿舊型錄估算採購費用時，以前會因為上頭的單價太高，把預估總額算高；現在手邊的備用型錄更新了，就能按正確的單價估算費用。⟧
body.en: If downloading the LiteLLM pricing table fails, Sonnet 5.5 costs might be overestimated. usage normally connects to download the LiteLLM pricing table, activating the fallback list only when that download fails. However, this fallback table previously retained outdated rates, pricing Sonnet 5.5 cache reads too expensively. Now this offline price table has been corrected, updating read pricing from $0.20 to $0.10 per million tokens (the text units for AI processing and billing), so Sonnet 5.5 offline expenses are no longer overestimated. ⟦When estimating procurement costs from an old catalog, inflated unit prices previously made the projected total too high, but now that the backup catalog on hand is updated, expenses are calculated using the correct unit prices.⟧

items.original: **Sonnet 5.5 cache reads in the offline price table cost $0.10 per million tokens.** The table, used only when the LiteLLM download fails, still charged $0.20, so offline Sonnet 5.5 spending was overstated.

title.zh-TW: Claude Code 多視窗與背景代理不再干擾進度，輸入提示穩定保留
title.en: Claude Code Multi-Window and Background Agents No Longer Interfere with Progress, Keeping Input Hints Stable

body.zh-TW:
你在同專案開多個 Claude Code 視窗或呼叫背景代理時，現在各項操作不再彼此干擾。⟦跟在共用辦公室工作一樣，以前只要隔壁同事動筆或助理跑腿，櫃檯就把你正在選的便籤收走、甚至塞來隔壁的文件；現在分工清楚，不再錯拿進度。⟧

以前開啟新視窗進行進度交接，常會誤接隔壁仍在跑的對話；現在會跳過其他開著且 10 分鐘內有寫入的工作階段，剛關閉的視窗仍正常交接。背景任務完成通知、以 `!` 執行的指令與無參數斜線指令，也不再被當成最近需求。

自 Claude Code 2.1.299 起，背景子代理或隊友開始回合時會誤觸訊號，清空輸入框上方的新手模式名詞；現在只有主對話展開新回合才會清除，挑字不再被中途打斷。
body.en:
When opening multiple Claude Code windows or calling background agents in the same project, operations no longer interfere with one another. ⟦Like working in a shared office, whenever a neighboring colleague started writing or an assistant ran an errand, the front desk used to take away the sticky note you were choosing or even hand you paperwork from next door; now responsibilities are clearly divided, so progress is never mixed up.⟧

Previously, opening a new window for progress handoff often mistakenly attached to an ongoing conversation next door; now, sessions that remain open with writes within 10 minutes are skipped, while recently closed windows still hand off normally. Background task completion notifications, commands run with `!`, and slash commands without arguments are also no longer treated as recent requests.

Since Claude Code 2.1.299, when background subagents or teammates started a turn, they accidentally triggered a signal that cleared Beginner Mode terms above the input box; now, they are cleared only when the main conversation starts a new turn, so selecting words is no longer interrupted midway.

items.original:
**Session resume no longer hands over another open window's work.** With several Claude Code windows in one project, a new window picked up whichever session was written last, often a neighbour still running. Sessions another window has open and wrote to in the last 10 minutes are now skipped; a window you just closed is still handed over. Background-task notices, `!` shell runs and bare slash commands no longer show up as your recent requests.
**Beginner Mode's terms stay up while background agents work.** Since Claude Code 2.1.299, a subagent or teammate starting its own turn also signals a new turn, which cleared the terms above the prompt and dropped the ones still being picked. Only a new turn in the main conversation clears them now.

entries: **usage uses far less CPU while it sits in the menu bar.** With the panel closed, a refresh took about 1.2 s of CPU and could run three times a minute, about 6% CPU on average while you work. Incremental history scans no longer list every Muse session again for each changed file, Muse sessions are reparsed only when they change, and resolved Claude project names are cached. A steady-state refresh now takes about 0.13 s.

**Closing the panel frees the memory of panels you browsed.** Each panel you switched to kept its own WebKit process after the panel closed, up to six and about 400 MB. Now only the current panel stays loaded once the panel closes. Switching while it is open is unchanged.

**Claude Desktop quota remains available when plan history stops updating.** A fresh local HTTP quota response for the latest history organization can now supply percentages and reset times even after the history sample expires. Expired responses, invalid organizations and another account's cache still return no data.
**The panel's right-click menu no longer offers Reload.** The v0.22.5 fix looked up the wrong menu item property, so right-click > Reload still blanked the panel (#42).

**Claude Haiku 5.5 has prices and a short name.** Its cost no longer drops out when the online price table is unreachable, and reports show "Haiku 5.5" instead of the raw model ID. The Auto-start 5-hour Session tooltip and dialog now name Gemini 3.8 Flash Low for Antigravity.
**Claude Desktop quota finds responses in Chromium's follow-on cache files.** Once the cache outgrew its first entry file, a fresh quota response could sit in a follow-on file and be missed.

**A Claude log that cannot be read is retried on the next refresh.** A brief lock, for example an antivirus scan on Windows, used to leave that file's usage missing until the file changed or usage restarted.
**Codex usage after a mid-session model switch is priced with the model that ran it.** Earlier turns were priced as the session's latest model. Codex history is reparsed once after this update.

title.zh-TW: 選單列常駐更輕巧，減輕處理器與記憶體負擔
title.en: Menu bar footprint is lighter, easing CPU and memory load

body.zh-TW: 長時間開著電腦工作，常駐在選單列的工具往往在不知不覺中吃掉大把電力與運算效能。⟦如同請了一位細心管家，以前客廳沒人也每分鐘全屋清點三次，離開房間還開著每盞燈；現在物品變動才核對，走出房門隨手關燈。⟧以前面板關閉時，每次刷新要花約 1.2 秒處理器時間，一分鐘可跑三次，工作時平均吃掉約 6% 運算效能。現在增量掃描不再因個別檔案變動就重列所有 Muse 工作階段，工作階段有變才重新解析，並把查好的 Claude 專案名稱放進快取（把算過或查過的結果暫存起來直接用），穩定狀態下刷新只要約 0.13 秒。關閉面板後，以前切換過的面板會各自殘留 WebKit 程序，最多達六個且佔用約 400 MB 記憶體；現在關閉後只保留目前這款，開著時切換的體驗維持不變。
body.en: When working on a computer for long hours, tools residing in the menu bar often drain significant power and processing capacity unnoticed. ⟦Think of hiring a meticulous housekeeper: previously, even when the living room was empty, they did a full inventory three times a minute and left every light on after leaving a room; now, they only check inventory when items change and turn off lights upon leaving.⟧ Previously, when the popover was closed, each refresh consumed about 1.2 seconds of CPU time and could run three times a minute, taking up an average of about 6% of compute capacity during work. Now, incremental scanning no longer re-lists all Muse sessions whenever an individual file changes; it only re-parses when sessions change and caches retrieved Claude project names, reducing steady-state refresh time to about 0.13 seconds. After closing the popover, previously switched popovers each left behind WebKit processes, reaching up to six processes and consuming about 400 MB of memory; now only the current one is retained after closing, while the switching experience remains unchanged when open.

items.original:
**usage uses far less CPU while it sits in the menu bar.** With the panel closed, a refresh took about 1.2 s of CPU and could run three times a minute, about 6% CPU on average while you work. Incremental history scans no longer list every Muse session again for each changed file, Muse sessions are reparsed only when they change, and resolved Claude project names are cached. A steady-state refresh now takes about 0.13 s.
**Closing the panel frees the memory of panels you browsed.** Each panel you switched to kept its own WebKit process after the panel closed, up to six and about 400 MB. Now only the current panel stays loaded once the panel closes. Switching while it is open is unchanged.

title.zh-TW: Claude Desktop 額度穩定讀取，過期或被鎖檔不再缺漏
title.en: Claude Desktop quota reads reliably, no longer dropping when expired or locked

body.zh-TW: 現在追蹤 Claude Desktop 用量，不必再擔心額度數字莫名變空白或紀錄突然中斷。即使方案歷史紀錄已過期，只要最新歷史組織仍有新鮮的本機 HTTP 額度回應，就能繼續顯示百分比與重置時間；至於過期回應、無效組織以及其他帳號的快取（把查過的結果暫存起來直接用），則依然不會提供資料。當本機快取資料量超出第一個項目檔時，新的額度回應可能會被寫入 Chromium 的接續檔案，以前會因此漏掉，現在也能順利找到並讀取。遇到 Claude 紀錄檔短暫被鎖住時，例如 Windows 防毒軟體正在背景掃描，以前用量會一直缺漏直到檔案變更或重開軟體，現在會在下次刷新時自動重試讀取。以前你會卡在防毒軟體一掃描或快取一分卷就看不到額度、非得重開程式才能恢復，現在這些邊緣狀況都能自動銜接，讓你隨時看得到剩餘額度。
body.en: When tracking Claude Desktop usage, you no longer have to worry about quota numbers mysteriously turning blank or records suddenly dropping out. Even if plan history is expired, percentage and reset time continue to display as long as the latest historical organization still has fresh local HTTP quota responses; expired responses, invalid organizations, and caches from other accounts will still not provide data. When local cache data exceeds the first entry file, new quota responses may be written to Chromium continuation files; previously missed, they are now located and read smoothly. When Claude log files are temporarily locked, such as during background scans by Windows antivirus software, usage previously stayed missing until files changed or the app was restarted; it now automatically retries reading on the next refresh. Where you previously lost sight of your quota whenever antivirus scanned or the cache split into multiple volumes—forcing an app restart to recover—these edge cases are now handled seamlessly so your remaining quota stays visible.

items.original:
**Claude Desktop quota remains available when plan history stops updating.** A fresh local HTTP quota response for the latest history organization can now supply percentages and reset times even after the history sample expires. Expired responses, invalid organizations and another account's cache still return no data.
**Claude Desktop quota finds responses in Chromium's follow-on cache files.** Once the cache outgrew its first entry file, a fresh quota response could sit in a follow-on file and be missed.
**A Claude log that cannot be read is retried on the next refresh.** A brief lock, for example an antivirus scan on Windows, used to leave that file's usage missing until the file changed or usage restarted.

title.zh-TW: 模型計費回歸實際執行，報表名稱與定價不再漏失
title.en: Model billing reflects actual execution, keeping report names and pricing intact

body.zh-TW: 如果在 AI 費用明細裡看到一長串難懂的原始代碼，甚至換了模型卻被整筆高價計費，肯定讓人一頭霧水。⟦猶如請不同專長師傅接力修繕，以前只要後半段換了資深師傅，前半段學徒做的一律全照資深工資收費；現在每一段工時都按實際動手的師傅計價，帳單上也直接印出清楚簡稱。⟧當你在 Codex 對話中途切換模型時，用量現在會依照實際執行的模型分別計價；以前較早的回合會全部照該工作階段（session，一段持續對話的互動歷程）最後使用的模型來算，這次更新後會重新解析一次 Codex 歷史紀錄以修正帳目。Claude Haiku 5.5 也有了專屬定價與簡稱，連不上線上價目表時費用不會再消失，報表也會直接顯示簡稱而非原始模型 ID。而自動啟動 5 小時計時的提示與對話框，針對 Antigravity 也已正確改標為 Gemini 3.8 Flash Low。
body.en: Seeing cryptic raw IDs on an AI expense breakdown—or being billed entirely at higher rates after switching models—is bound to cause confusion. ⟦Picture specialized craftspeople taking turns on a renovation: previously, switching to a senior specialist midway meant earlier work by an apprentice was billed entirely at senior rates; now, each segment of labor is priced by who actually performed the work, and invoices clearly print clean short names.⟧ When you switch models mid-conversation in Codex, usage is now priced separately according to the model that actually ran. Earlier turns were previously billed entirely under the session's final model, but this update re-parses Codex history to correct the records. Claude Haiku 5.5 now has dedicated pricing and a short name; costs no longer disappear when offline from online pricing tables, and reports display its short name instead of the raw model ID. Additionally, prompts and dialogs that auto-start a 5-hour timer are now correctly relabeled as Gemini 3.8 Flash Low for Antigravity.

items.original:
**Claude Haiku 5.5 has prices and a short name.** Its cost no longer drops out when the online price table is unreachable, and reports show "Haiku 5.5" instead of the raw model ID. The Auto-start 5-hour Session tooltip and dialog now name Gemini 3.8 Flash Low for Antigravity.
**Codex usage after a mid-session model switch is priced with the model that ran it.** Earlier turns were priced as the session's latest model. Codex history is reparsed once after this update.

title.zh-TW: 面板右鍵選單移除重新載入，不再讓面板變空白
title.en: Reload removed from popover context menu, preventing blank screens

body.zh-TW: 許多人習慣在小工具畫面上按右鍵重新整理，以前這個動作卻可能讓面板變成一片空白。⟦就像遙控器上留了一顆容易誤觸的工程按鍵，以前隨手碰到會讓電視畫面變成一片空白，現在直接拆掉那顆按鈕，怎麼按都不怕出問題。⟧先前 v0.22.5 雖然曾嘗試修正這項問題，卻因為查錯了選單項目的屬性，導致你在面板上點擊滑鼠右鍵選擇『重新載入』時，依然會讓整個面板變成空白畫面。右鍵選單裡的『重新載入』已移除，這個問題已經修好。
body.en: Many users are used to right-clicking on widget screens to refresh, but this action previously risked turning the popover completely blank. ⟦Consider an easily bumped engineering button left on a remote control: previously, an accidental touch turned the TV screen blank, but removing that button entirely ensures nothing goes wrong no matter what you press.⟧ Although v0.22.5 previously attempted to address this issue, checking the wrong menu item property meant that right-clicking on the popover and selecting 'Reload' still caused the entire popover to become a blank screen. 'Reload' has now been removed from the context menu, fixing this issue.

items.original: **The panel's right-click menu no longer offers Reload.** The v0.22.5 fix looked up the wrong menu item property, so right-click > Reload still blanked the panel (#42).

entries: **Project names show for folders with dots, underscores, non-English names or emoji.** Claude Code turns every symbol in a project path into `-`, so these projects showed the whole encoded string or the parent folder's name. usage now matches the encoded name against the real folders, including long paths Claude Code shortens.

**Quota-Aware Mode only asks about the quota a task uses.** An exhausted Antigravity model group made Claude ask whether to wait before unrelated work. The reminder now says each quota and model group is separate. Quota-Aware hook 1.1; the installed copy updates the next time you open the app.
**Side pane session toasts name the project.** A toast that a session finished now starts with the project name, so you can tell which window it was.

title.zh-TW: 特殊符號與中文資料夾，專案清單正確顯示原始名稱
title.en: Project list correctly displays original names for folders with special symbols and Chinese characters

body.zh-TW: 當你的專案資料夾名稱包含點號、底線、中文或表情符號（emoji）時，打開 usage 就能一眼認出它是誰。Claude Code 會把路徑裡的所有符號都換成減號 `-`。過去遇到這類專案，畫面往往只會顯示一長串編碼後的名稱，甚至直接顯示上一層資料夾的名字。若是路徑太長被 Claude Code 截短，對照也會直接失效。現在 usage 會拿編碼後的名稱回頭比對真實資料夾，就算長路徑被截短也能精準對上。⟦跟機場行李託運掛牌一樣，以前行李條碼若被縮寫成代號，地勤人員只能念出一整串編碼，現在系統會自動拿代號反查原始旅客姓名，把正確名牌亮出來。⟧
body.en: When your project folder name contains dots, underscores, Chinese characters, or emoji, you can instantly recognize it upon opening usage. Claude Code replaces all symbols in a path with hyphens `-`. In the past, the screen often showed only a long encoded name or even the parent folder's name for such projects. If a path was too long and truncated by Claude Code, the matching broke completely. Now, usage compares the encoded name back against real folders, matching them accurately even if long paths get truncated. ⟦Picture airport baggage tags: in the past, if a baggage barcode was abbreviated into a code, ground staff could only read out a long encoded string; now the system automatically cross-references the code to find the traveler's original name and display the correct luggage tag.⟧

items.original: **Project names show for folders with dots, underscores, non-English names or emoji.** Claude Code turns every symbol in a project path into `-`, so these projects showed the whole encoded string or the parent folder's name. usage now matches the encoded name against the real folders, including long paths Claude Code shortens.

title.zh-TW: 額度感知模式智慧判定，只在用到的額度耗盡時提醒
title.en: Quota-aware mode intelligently alerts only when the relevant quota is exhausted

body.zh-TW: 當你在 Antigravity 裡耗盡了某個模型組的額度時，切換到 Claude 執行完全無關的工作不會再被無端打斷。以前額度感知模式只要發現任一模型組用完，即使當前任務完全用不到它，Claude 也會先詢問你要不要等待。現在提醒訊息會明確說明每份額度與模型組各自獨立，只會在任務確實會動用到該額度時才發問。這項改動隨額度感知掛鉤（hook，事件發生時自動攔截並處理的小程式）升級至 1.1 版推出，電腦中已安裝的副本會在下次啟動應用程式時自動更新。⟦像在美食街各家櫃位點餐，以前只要有一家拉麵店賣光，不管你點的是漢堡還是飲料，店員都會跑來問你要不要等拉麵，現在各家櫃位分開叫號，只在你想買的餐點售完時才會確認。⟧
body.en: When you exhaust a model group's quota in Antigravity, switching to Claude for completely unrelated tasks will no longer be interrupted unnecessarily. Previously, whenever quota-aware mode detected that any model group was depleted, Claude would ask if you wanted to wait, even if the current task did not use it at all. Alert messages now clarify that each quota and model group operates independently, prompting you only when a task actually requires that quota. This update is released alongside version 1.1 of the quota-aware hook (a lightweight script triggered on specific events), and local installations will update automatically the next time the app starts. ⟦Think of ordering food across different stalls in a food court: in the past, if a ramen stall ran out of food, the staff would ask whether you wanted to wait for ramen even if you ordered a burger or drink; now each stall calls numbers independently and only checks with you when the item you want is sold out.⟧

items.original: **Quota-Aware Mode only asks about the quota a task uses.** An exhausted Antigravity model group made Claude ask whether to wait before unrelated work. The reminder now says each quota and model group is separate. Quota-Aware hook 1.1; the installed copy updates the next time you open the app.

title.zh-TW: 側邊面板對話完成通知，開頭標註所屬專案名稱
title.en: Side panel completion notifications prefix the corresponding project name

body.zh-TW: 當你桌面上一口氣開了好幾個視窗平行趕工時，螢幕角落跳出的提醒往往讓人摸不著頭緒。側邊面板跳出的工作階段完成通知，現在開頭會直接標明專案名稱。以前通知只會顯示對話已經完成，在多工處理時根本分不清是哪一個視窗跑完；現在看一眼通知標題就能立刻知道是哪個專案搞定，切換視窗不再手忙腳亂。⟦就像快遞櫃發送取件通知，以前簡訊只寫『包裹已送達』讓人分不清寄來的是哪一件，現在開頭直接標明商品名稱，一眼就能確認哪批貨到手。⟧
body.en: When working across multiple open windows in parallel on your desktop, alerts popping up in the corner of your screen can easily be confusing. Session completion notifications from the side panel now directly include the project name at the beginning. In the past, notifications only stated that a conversation had finished, making it difficult to tell which window completed during multitasking; now a single glance at the notification title tells you exactly which project is done, eliminating the hassle of switching between windows. ⟦Like parcel locker pickup notifications: previously, SMS alerts only said "Package delivered," leaving you unsure which item had arrived; now the product name is clearly labeled at the beginning, letting you instantly confirm which package is ready.⟧

items.original: **Side pane session toasts name the project.** A toast that a session finished now starts with the project name, so you can tell which window it was.

entries: **Claude quota shows even with only Claude Desktop installed.** When Claude Code quota files are unavailable, usage reads Claude Desktop's local plan history, including Windows Microsoft Store installs. It shows session and weekly percentages, plus exact reset times from a matching, recent local HTTP cache response when available. No credentials or quota API requests; unknown reset times remain unknown. Includes observation age and stale-data handling.

**On Windows, right-clicking the taskbar quota label opens the menu.** It is the same menu as the tray icon, shown outside the taskbar so it cannot cover the menu. Adapts to taskbars on any screen edge; left-click still opens the panel.

**Windows gets Beginner Mode and Quota-Aware Mode switches.** They sit with the side pane under a **Claude Code** submenu in the tray menu, as on macOS. On Windows, Quota-Aware Mode now also sees Codex and Antigravity quota.

title.zh-TW: 沒裝 Claude Code，只靠桌面版也能查額度
title.en: Check your quota from the desktop app alone, no Claude Code install needed

body.zh-TW: 平常習慣直接打開桌面版軟體跟 AI 聊天，現在不用另外裝命令列工具也能隨時盯緊用量。找不到 Claude Code 的額度檔時，程式會改去讀取 Claude 桌面版的本機歷史紀錄，連 Windows 的微軟商店安裝版也支援。畫面上能直接看見工作階段與每週的使用百分比。要是本機 HTTP 快取（暫存查過資料的地方）剛好留有近期一致的回應，還會附上準確的重置時間。整趟過程不使用登入憑證，也不發送額度 API（查詢額度的介面）請求，遇到沒把握的時間絕不瞎猜，還會清楚標示資料是多久以前記下的，也會處理過期資料。⟦像在辦公桌瞄一眼牆上的出勤打卡白板，以前沒領到專屬通行證就完全看不到剩餘天數，現在直接幫你把公佈欄的現成紀錄抄過來，既不用額外跑去人資櫃檯重問，也不會偷翻你的私人抽屜。⟧
body.en: If you usually just open the desktop app to chat with the AI, you can now keep an eye on usage anytime without installing a separate command-line tool. When the program can't find Claude Code's quota file, it falls back to reading the Claude desktop app's local history, and it even supports the Microsoft Store install on Windows. The screen shows your session and weekly usage percentages directly. If the local HTTP cache (where previously fetched data is temporarily stored) happens to hold a recent matching response, it also includes the accurate reset time. The whole process uses no login credentials and sends no quota API (the interface for querying quota) requests; it never guesses at times it isn't sure about, clearly marks how long ago the data was recorded, and handles stale data. ⟦Picture glancing at the attendance whiteboard on the office wall from your desk: before, without your own access pass you couldn't see the remaining days at all, but now the existing records on the bulletin board are simply copied over for you—no extra trip to the HR counter to ask again, and no peeking into your private drawer.⟧

items.original: **Claude quota shows even with only Claude Desktop installed.** When Claude Code quota files are unavailable, usage reads Claude Desktop's local plan history, including Windows Microsoft Store installs. It shows session and weekly percentages, plus exact reset times from a matching, recent local HTTP cache response when available. No credentials or quota API requests; unknown reset times remain unknown. Includes observation age and stale-data handling.

title.zh-TW: Windows 工作列右鍵點額度標籤，立刻跳出選單
title.en: Right-click the quota label on the Windows taskbar and a menu pops up instantly

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 桌面緊盯剩餘額度時，不必特地把滑鼠移到角落找小圖示。現在只要直接在工作列的額度文字上按滑鼠右鍵，就能叫出跟系統匣（螢幕角落放背景小圖示的區域）一模一樣的功能選單。彈出的選單會自動顯示在工作列外側，不管你把工作列釘在螢幕的上下左右哪一邊都不會被遮蔽。至於原本用滑鼠左鍵點擊的習慣依然保留，按一下同樣會打開完整的額度面板。⟦宛如在電視邊框摸到快捷鍵，以前要調模式非得跑回主機面板按選單，現在隨手一按就跳出懸浮視窗，還會自動閃開邊框不擋住螢幕。⟧
body.en: When watching your remaining quota on the Windows desktop, you no longer have to move the mouse to a corner hunting for a tiny icon. Now just right-click directly on the quota text in the taskbar to summon the exact same function menu as the system tray (the area in the screen corner that holds background icons). The pop-up menu automatically appears outside the taskbar, so it never gets covered no matter which edge of the screen—top, bottom, left, or right—you pin the taskbar to. The original left-click habit is kept too: one click still opens the full quota panel. ⟦Like finding a shortcut button on the TV frame: before, switching modes meant walking back to the main unit's panel to press the menu, but now a casual press pops up a floating window that automatically moves clear of the frame so it doesn't block the screen.⟧

items.original: **On Windows, right-clicking the taskbar quota label opens the menu.** It is the same menu as the tray icon, shown outside the taskbar so it cannot cover the menu. Adapts to taskbars on any screen edge; left-click still opens the panel.

title.zh-TW: Windows 版加入新手與額度感知開關，跨工具用量一覽無遺
title.en: Windows gains newcomer and quota-aware toggles, with cross-tool usage at a glance

body.zh-TW: 在 Windows 上找 Claude Code 的模式開關時，現在可以直接到系統匣選單操作。系統匣選單裡的「Claude Code」子選單現在補齊了新手模式與額度感知模式這兩項開關，跟側邊面板放在同一個群組，操作體驗直接對齊 macOS。開啟額度感知模式後，系統在 Windows 上也能跨界讀取 Codex 與 Antigravity 的額度狀況，幫你一手掌握不同助理的消耗進度。⟦彷彿在多功能儀表板上裝了整合切換鈕，以前要看各家工具的用量得自己逐一開分頁對照，現在打開同一個抽屜就能直接切換模式，連其他幫手的剩餘油量也能順便讀到。⟧
body.en: When looking for Claude Code's mode switches on Windows, you can now operate them straight from the system tray menu. The "Claude Code" submenu in the system tray menu now includes both the newcomer mode and quota-aware mode toggles, grouped together with the side panel so the experience matches macOS directly. Once quota-aware mode is on, the system can also read the quota status of Codex and Antigravity across tools on Windows, helping you track the consumption progress of different assistants in one place. ⟦Think of a unified toggle added to a multi-function dashboard: before, checking each tool's usage meant opening tabs one by one to compare them yourself, but now you open a single drawer to switch modes directly, and even the remaining fuel of the other helpers gets read along the way.⟧

items.original: **Windows gets Beginner Mode and Quota-Aware Mode switches.** They sit with the side pane under a **Claude Code** submenu in the tray menu, as on macOS. On Windows, Quota-Aware Mode now also sees Codex and Antigravity quota.

entries: **Beginner Mode helps you read Claude Code's answers.** After an answer, up to three technical terms appear above the prompt, each with a one-line plain explanation in your UI language. Press 9 to mark them understood; skipped terms come back after 1, 3, then 7 days. `/terms` opens your term history. Picking terms asks Claude Haiku through your Claude Code, so it uses a little Claude quota, and it pauses while your 5-hour quota is at 90% or more. macOS, off by default.

**Beginner Mode quizzes you on terms you understood.** A new conversation can open with a one-question multiple-choice quiz on a term you marked understood, 7, 21, then 60 days later, at most one a day. A wrong answer puts the term back in the hints.

**Quota-Aware Mode tells Claude when quota runs low.** When a 5-hour quota passes 80%, 90% or 95%, or a weekly quota passes 95%, Claude Code gets one line with what is left and when it resets. Before a big task, Claude tells you and lets you pick a smaller part or wait. It covers Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, says each level once per conversation, and makes no extra model calls. macOS, off by default.
**Claude Code switches have their own submenu.** Side pane, Beginner Mode and Quota-Aware Mode sit under a **Claude Code** submenu in the menu bar menu, like the panel themes.

**The rate label compares you with yourself.** Idle, Normal, Active and Heavy now come from your own last 30 days: hours below your 25th percentile are Idle, and only your top 5% are Heavy. Fixed limits labelled a normal Opus session Heavy almost all the time. Until there are 24 hours of history, the old limits apply.

title.zh-TW: 新手模式帶你看懂專有名詞，搭配隨堂測驗加深記憶
title.en: Beginner mode explains technical terms and reinforces memory with quick quizzes

body.zh-TW: 剛開始接觸指令列工具時，終端機跳出的艱澀字詞常讓人看得一頭霧水。macOS 版現在新增預設關閉的新手模式，在 Claude Code 回答完後，會在輸入框上方挑出最多 3 個專有名詞，並附上一行與介面相同語言的白話解釋。你可以按 9 標記為懂了，略過的名詞會在 1、3、7 天後再次出現。隨時輸入 `/terms` 就能翻閱名詞紀錄。開啟新對話時，可以針對你已標記懂了的名詞，在 7、21、60 天後出一題選擇題，一天最多一題，答錯的名詞則會重新回到提示清單。挑選名詞會透過你的 Claude Code 請 Claude Haiku 協助並消耗少量額度，當 5 小時額度達到 90% 以上時會自動暫停。⟦跟用單字卡箱複習生字一樣，以前看過的名詞容易轉頭就忘，現在標記懂了後按既定間隔複習，答錯的卡片則回到提示清單。⟧
body.en: When first using command-line tools, obscure terms appearing in the terminal often feel confusing. The macOS version adds a beginner mode that is off by default. After Claude Code finishes responding, it picks up to 3 technical terms above the input box and provides a one-line plain-language explanation in the same language as your interface. You can press 9 to mark a term as understood, while skipped terms reappear after 1, 3, and 7 days. Entering `/terms` at any time lets you browse your term history. When starting a new conversation, it can present one multiple-choice question on terms you marked as understood after 7, 21, and 60 days, up to one question per day, and incorrectly answered terms return to the hint list. Selecting terms asks Claude Haiku for assistance through your Claude Code and consumes a small amount of quota, automatically pausing when the 5-hour quota reaches 90% or higher. ⟦Like reviewing vocabulary with a flashcard box, terms seen before were once easy to forget quickly, but now marking them as understood reviews them at set intervals, with missed cards returning to the hint list.⟧

items.original:
**Beginner Mode helps you read Claude Code's answers.** After an answer, up to three technical terms appear above the prompt, each with a one-line plain explanation in your UI language. Press 9 to mark them understood; skipped terms come back after 1, 3, then 7 days. `/terms` opens your term history. Picking terms asks Claude Haiku through your Claude Code, so it uses a little Claude quota, and it pauses while your 5-hour quota is at 90% or more. macOS, off by default.
**Beginner Mode quizzes you on terms you understood.** A new conversation can open with a one-question multiple-choice quiz on a term you marked understood, 7, 21, then 60 days later, at most one a day. A wrong answer puts the term back in the hints.

title.zh-TW: 額度快用完時主動通報，讓 AI 開大任務前先跟你商量
title.en: Proactive quota notifications let AI consult you before starting large tasks

body.zh-TW: 當你準備把一整份複雜專案交給 AI 處理時，最怕做到一半突然撞上限額而中斷。macOS 版新增預設關閉的額度感知模式，當 5 小時額度超過 80%、90%、95%，或週額度超過 95% 時，Claude Code 就會收到一行提示，寫明剩餘額度與重置時間。在展開大型任務前，Claude 會先提醒你額度吃緊，由你選擇先做局部小任務或等待重置。這項功能支援 Claude Code、Codex 與 Antigravity，每個額度門檻在同一個對話中只會通報一次，且不會產生額外的模型呼叫。⟦彷彿開車上高速公路時儀表板主動亮燈，以前油箱見底你可能還毫不知情，現在副駕駛會提早報出剩餘油量與下個加油站距離，好決定先換小路或等補給。⟧
body.en: When handing an entire complex project to AI, the biggest worry is being interrupted halfway through by hitting limits. The macOS version adds a quota-aware mode that is disabled by default. When the 5-hour quota exceeds 80%, 90%, or 95%, or the weekly quota exceeds 95%, Claude Code receives a one-line prompt specifying remaining quota and reset time. Before starting large tasks, Claude warns you that quota is tight, leaving you to choose between tackling smaller subtasks first or waiting for a reset. This feature supports Claude Code, Codex, and Antigravity, reporting each quota threshold only once per conversation without generating extra model calls. ⟦Picture a dashboard lighting up while driving on the highway; previously you might not notice an empty tank, but now a co-pilot announces remaining fuel and distance to the next station early so you can choose side roads or wait for refueling.⟧

items.original: **Quota-Aware Mode tells Claude when quota runs low.** When a 5-hour quota passes 80%, 90% or 95%, or a weekly quota passes 95%, Claude Code gets one line with what is left and when it resets. Before a big task, Claude tells you and lets you pick a smaller part or wait. It covers Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity, says each level once per conversation, and makes no extra model calls. macOS, off by default.

title.zh-TW: Claude Code 開關收進專屬子選單，選單列更清爽
title.en: Claude Code toggles move into a dedicated submenu for a cleaner menu bar

body.zh-TW: 想在選單列中快速調整工具設定時，若所有開關都堆在同一層，容易讓人眼花撩亂。現在側邊面板、新手模式與額度感知模式這三項開關，集中在選單列選單中的「Claude Code」專屬子選單，就像面板主題一樣集中管理。現在歸類後不僅讓主選單畫面更為清爽，找尋相關功能也更直覺。⟦如同工具箱用專用隔層收納同系列工具，現在要查看這三項開關，就打開標著 Claude Code 的那一格，能一起看到它們。⟧
body.en: When adjusting tool settings quickly from the menu bar, stacking all switches on the same level easily causes clutter. The side panel, beginner mode, and quota-aware mode toggles are now gathered into a dedicated "Claude Code" submenu within the menu bar menu, managed centrally just like popover themes. Organizing them makes the main menu cleaner and locating related features more intuitive. ⟦Think of a toolbox using dedicated compartments for related tools; checking these three toggles now means opening the section labeled Claude Code to see them all together.⟧

items.original: **Claude Code switches have their own submenu.** Side pane, Beginner Mode and Quota-Aware Mode sit under a **Claude Code** submenu in the menu bar menu, like the panel themes.

title.zh-TW: 速率標籤改跟自己比，不再動輒誤報高負載
title.en: Rate labels benchmark against your history to reduce false high load warnings

body.zh-TW: 平時透過介面觀察自己的用量速率時，很容易發現指標動不動就亮起高負載。現在閒置、正常、活躍與高負載四種速率標籤，改用你過去 30 天的個人用量紀錄來劃分。用量排在最低 25% 的時段算閒置，只有衝進你最忙碌的前 5% 時才會標記為高負載。以往固定的統計門檻，會讓平常的 Opus 工作階段幾乎全程顯示高負載。在歷史紀錄累積滿 24 小時之前，則會暫時沿用舊門檻。⟦像運動手錶按你自己的體能設定心率區間，以前拿運動員的標準來套，稍微慢跑就整路狂響高負荷警報，現在改對齊你平時的心跳分佈，真正衝刺時才亮紅燈。⟧
body.en: When monitoring your usage rate through the interface, indicators frequently trigger high load warnings unnecessarily. The four rate labels—idle, normal, active, and high load—are now classified using your personal usage history over the past 30 days. Periods in your lowest 25% of usage count as idle, while only spikes reaching your busiest top 5% are marked as high load. Previously, fixed statistical thresholds caused regular Opus sessions to display high load almost the entire time. Before 24 hours of history accumulate, the old thresholds are temporarily used. ⟦A sports watch customizes heart rate zones to your fitness; applying an athlete's standard once caused heavy load alarms during light jogs, but calibrating to your normal heart rate distribution lights up red only when truly sprinting.⟧

items.original: **The rate label compares you with yourself.** Idle, Normal, Active and Heavy now come from your own last 30 days: hours below your 25th percentile are Idle, and only your top 5% are Heavy. Fixed limits labelled a normal Opus session Heavy almost all the time. Until there are 24 hours of history, the old limits apply.

entries: **Context color now accounts for window size.** The figure turns yellow at 50% or 200K tokens and red at 80% or 400K tokens, whichever comes first. On a 1M window, yellow now appears at about 20%. 200K windows are unchanged.
**Side pane colors match the status line.** The Claude Code side pane moves from 70% / 85% to the same rule.

**Terse mode uses shorter sentences.** Replies keep one idea per sentence, use active voice and consistent terms, and follow a length limit per language: about 20 words in English, 30 characters in Chinese, 40 in Japanese and Korean. The terse hook is now 1.7; installed copies update on the next app launch.

**Context breakdown in the status line.** When the context figure turns yellow or red, the status line shows the image count and the estimated share of file reads and command output, for example `Images 3 · Files & commands 22%`. A high share suggests starting a new conversation. This segment is dropped first when space runs out. The status line hook is now 1.14; installed copies update on the next app launch.

**Release notes after an update.** The first launch after an update shows what changed in that version, once. Fresh installs skip it. If the app is offline, it tries again on the next launch. macOS and Windows.

**Release notes in your language.** Update alerts list one line per change. Chinese users see Traditional Chinese; other languages see English. This applies to the update alert from the version after this one, because the alert is drawn by the version you already have.
**The app's code signature is valid again.** The build re-signs the app after it removes bytecode caches, so `codesign --verify` passes on downloaded copies.

title.zh-TW: 上下文用量依容量變色，側邊面板警示同步
title.en: Context usage color adapts to capacity, syncing sidebar panel alerts

body.zh-TW: 當你跟 AI 進行長篇對話時，往往需要留意用量是否快要超出容量上限。⟦好比大水庫與小水槽改用不同的警報線，以前側邊面板跟狀態列各自看不同比例，現在兩邊統一套用相同標準，遇到超大容量更會提早亮起黃燈提醒。⟧上下文視窗現在會依照總容量來判斷顏色。用量達到 50% 或 200K token（AI 處理與計費的文字單位）時會變黃，達到 80% 或 400K token 時則變紅，並以先達到的一項為準。上下文容量為 1M 時，用量大約達到 20% 就會變黃；至於上下文容量為 200K 時，變色門檻則維持不變。Claude Code 側邊面板的警示標準也從原本的 70% 與 85% 改為這套新規則，讓側邊面板與狀態列的顏色完全保持一致。
body.en: During long conversations with AI, you often need to keep an eye on whether usage is nearing capacity limits. ⟦Think of large reservoirs and small basins adopting distinct alert lines: while the sidebar panel and status line previously tracked different thresholds, both now share a unified standard, triggering yellow warnings earlier for extra-large capacities.⟧ The context window now determines its color based on total capacity. Usage turns yellow at 50% or 200K tokens (units of text used for AI processing and billing), and turns red at 80% or 400K tokens, whichever threshold is reached first. With a 1M context window, usage turns yellow at roughly 20%; for a 200K context window, the color thresholds remain unchanged. Claude Code sidebar panel alerts have also switched to these new rules from the previous 70% and 85% marks, keeping colors between the sidebar panel and status line fully consistent.

items.original:
**Context color now accounts for window size.** The figure turns yellow at 50% or 200K tokens and red at 80% or 400K tokens, whichever comes first. On a 1M window, yellow now appears at about 20%. 200K windows are unchanged.
**Side pane colors match the status line.** The Claude Code side pane moves from 70% / 85% to the same rule.

title.zh-TW: 精簡模式改用短句回答，嚴格限制各語言長度
title.en: Concise mode adopts short sentences, strictly capping lengths across languages

body.zh-TW: 如果你習慣讓 AI 給出簡潔俐落的答案，開啟精簡模式時會發現回覆變得乾淨明快。⟦像專業速記員整理重點，以前回覆容易把好幾件事拖成冗長複句，現在規定每一句只講一個動作，並嚴格卡住字數上限，讀起來輕鬆省力。⟧精簡模式現在強制一句話只講一件事，一律採用主動語態，並針對同一概念使用一致的詞彙。回覆長度也依照語言設下嚴格上限，中文限制 30 字、日文與韓文限制 40 字，英文則約為 20 個單字。負責這項功能的精簡模式 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）版本已升級至 1.7，已安裝的副本會在下次開啟應用程式時自動更新。
body.en: If you prefer crisp answers from AI, turning on concise mode makes responses noticeably clear and punchy. ⟦Like a stenographer distilling key points, where answers previously dragged multiple ideas into lengthy compound sentences, every sentence must now convey just one action under strict length caps for effortless reading.⟧ Concise mode now enforces one idea per sentence, strictly adopts the active voice, and applies consistent terms for the same concept. Response length is also capped by language: 30 characters for Chinese, 40 characters for Japanese and Korean, and roughly 20 words for English. The concise mode hook (a small program triggered by a specific event) handling this feature has been upgraded to version 1.7, and installed copies will automatically update on the next application launch.

items.original: **Terse mode uses shorter sentences.** Replies keep one idea per sentence, use active voice and consistent terms, and follow a length limit per language: about 20 words in English, 30 characters in Chinese, 40 in Japanese and Korean. The terse hook is now 1.7; installed copies update on the next app launch.

title.zh-TW: 狀態列顯示用量組成，容量吃緊時拆解佔比
title.en: Status line reveals usage breakdown, detailing proportions under tight capacity

body.zh-TW: 把大量程式碼和截圖丟進對話後，一旦看到用量亮起警告，往往很難一眼看出到底是哪類內容在吃容量。⟦彷彿收納行李超重時跳出的明細清單，以前亮起紅燈你只能瞎猜是哪件物品太重，現在直接標出大件行李數量與雜物佔比，空間不足時還會自動把次要備註收起來。⟧當上下文（AI 在對話中能參考的內容）用量的數字變黃或變紅時，顯示在終端機最底下的狀態列會主動列出圖片數量，以及讀取檔案與指令輸出的估計佔比，例如 `圖片 3 張 · 讀檔與指令輸出 22%`。若該比例偏高，會建議你開啟新的對話工作階段。當狀態列空間不足時，這段組成資訊會最先被省略。狀態列 hook（掛鉤，特定事件發生時被觸發的小程式）已升級至 1.14，已安裝的副本會在下次開啟應用程式時更新。
body.en: After pasting extensive code and screenshots into a conversation, seeing a usage warning often leaves you wondering which content type is consuming capacity. ⟦Picture an itemized breakdown when luggage exceeds weight limits: instead of guessing which item caused the red alert, big pieces and clutter ratios are explicitly listed, with secondary notes automatically tucked away when space runs tight.⟧ The status line appears at the very bottom of the terminal. When context (the content AI can refer to in a conversation) usage numbers turn yellow or red, the status line actively displays image counts alongside estimated proportions for read files and command output, such as `Images 3 · Files & commands 22%`. If this percentage is high, it recommends starting a new conversation session. When status line space runs out, this breakdown information is omitted first. The status line hook (a small program triggered by a specific event) has been upgraded to 1.14, and installed copies will update on the next application launch.

items.original: **Context breakdown in the status line.** When the context figure turns yellow or red, the status line shows the image count and the estimated share of file reads and command output, for example `Images 3 · Files & commands 22%`. A high share suggests starting a new conversation. This segment is dropped first when space runs out. The status line hook is now 1.14; installed copies update on the next app launch.

title.zh-TW: 更新後自動顯示改版重點，提示支援繁體中文
title.en: Release highlights display automatically upon update, adding Traditional Chinese support

body.zh-TW: 每次應用程式自動升級之後，你往往需要確認剛剛到底改了哪些功能。⟦如同訂閱的雜誌改版時夾附一張母語重點摘要，以前更新完只能自己找改了什麼，現在一開門就遞上每項只寫一行的繁中清單，斷網時還會貼心留到下次再給。⟧現在更新後第一次開啟應用程式，畫面會主動跳出這一版的更新內容，而且只會顯示一次。全新安裝的使用者不會看到這項提示；若啟動時沒有網路連線，會在下次開啟時再次嘗試顯示。這項功能同時適用於 macOS 與 Windows 系統。更新提示中每項變更只會列出一行，中文使用者會看到繁體中文說明，其他語言的使用者則會看到英文。由於提示視窗是由你目前安裝的版本所繪製，多語言更新說明會從這版之後的下一版更新提示開始正式生效。
body.en: Whenever the application updates automatically, you often want to verify which features changed. ⟦A renewed magazine subscription includes a key summary in your native language: instead of hunting for changes on your own, a single-line Traditional Chinese list greets you immediately, quietly deferred to the next launch if you are offline.⟧ When you launch the application for the first time after an update, a release notes prompt appears on screen and shows only once. Fresh installations will not display this prompt, and if there is no internet connection at startup, it will try again on the next launch. This feature is supported across macOS and Windows. Each change in the update prompt takes only one line; Chinese users see Traditional Chinese descriptions, while other users see English. Because the prompt window is rendered by your currently installed version, multilingual release notes will officially take effect starting with the update prompt in the subsequent release.

items.original:
**Release notes after an update.** The first launch after an update shows what changed in that version, once. Fresh installs skip it. If the app is offline, it tries again on the next launch. macOS and Windows.
**Release notes in your language.** Update alerts list one line per change. Chinese users see Traditional Chinese; other languages see English. This applies to the update alert from the version after this one, because the alert is drawn by the version you already have.

title.zh-TW: 應用程式程式碼簽章恢復有效，下載後驗證順利通過
title.en: Application code signatures restored, passing verification after download

body.zh-TW: 如果你在 macOS 上下載應用程式後習慣手動驗證安全性，以前可能會因為簽章失效而無法通過檢查。⟦像出廠檢驗時重貼封條，以前如果在蓋完印章後又清理暫存碎屑，會弄破標籤導致檢查不過，現在改在徹底清乾淨後才重新壓上鋼印。⟧現在打包流程在清除位元組碼快取（cache，把編譯結果暫存起來直接用的檔案）後會重新進行數位簽章。下載後的應用程式副本都能順利通過 `codesign --verify` 驗證，讓程式碼簽章恢復有效。
body.en: If you manually verify application security after downloading on macOS, invalid signatures may have previously caused checks to fail. ⟦Much like reapplying factory seals during inspection, where clearing residual debris after stamping once tore the seal and failed verification, stamps are now reapplied after thorough cleanup.⟧ The packaging process now performs digital signing again after clearing bytecode caches. Downloaded application copies can now pass `codesign --verify` verification without issue, restoring valid code signatures.

items.original: **The app's code signature is valid again.** The build re-signs the app after it removes bytecode caches, so `codesign --verify` passes on downloaded copies.
